title: iPhone 18e Leaks: Apple’s Next Budget iPhone Tipped To Feature A20 Chip, 24MP Selfie Camera & 60Hz OLED Display; Check Expected Specifications, Launch Timeline & More
summary: Leaks reveal iPhone 18e features A20 chip, 24MP camera, and 60Hz display
detailed: iPhone 18e Leaks: Apple’s upcoming affordable smartphone, the iPhone 18e, has reportedly surfaced in new leaks, offering a glimpse into its expected specifications, camera upgrades and launch timeline.
According to a report by India Today published on November 4, 2026, the iPhone 18e could feature a 24-megapixel selfie camera and a 6.12-inch OLED display with a standard 60Hz refresh rate.
According to the reported specifications, the iPhone 18e may feature a 24-megapixel selfie camera, compared with the 12-megapixel front camera on the iPhone 17e.
The latest leaks suggest that the iPhone 18e could bring a new processor and a higher-resolution selfie camera while retaining a 60Hz OLED display and a single rear camera.
sentences: iPhone 18e Leaks: Apple’s upcoming affordable smartphone, the iPhone 18e, has reportedly surfaced in new leaks, offering a glimpse into its expected specifications, camera upgrades and launch timeline.
The successor to the iPhone 17e is tipped to receive Apple’s next-generation A20 chipset and an upgraded front-facing camera.
However, the company may continue to reserve some premium display features for its more expensive iPhone models.
According to a report by India Today published on November 4, 2026, the iPhone 18e could feature a 24-megapixel selfie camera and a 6.12-inch OLED display with a standard 60Hz refresh rate.
The information is attributed to Chinese tipster Digital Chat Station, who reportedly shared the specifications on Weibo.
Apple has not officially announced the iPhone 18e or confirmed any of the reported specifications.
Here is what the latest leaks suggest about the upcoming smartphone.
The iPhone 18e is expected to focus on internal hardware improvements rather than a major design overhaul.
The handset could feature a 6.12-inch LTPS OLED display with a 60Hz refresh rate, according to the latest leak.
If the reported specifications are accurate, Apple may retain the standard refresh rate instead of introducing a 120Hz ProMotion display.
This could remain one of the key differences between the more affordable ‘e’ series and Apple’s higher-priced smartphone models.
The display size is also tipped to increase slightly compared with the 6.1-inch screen on the iPhone 17e.
One of the biggest expected upgrades could be the processor.
The iPhone 18e is tipped to feature Apple’s next-generation A20 chipset, reportedly manufactured using a 2nm process.
This would represent an upgrade over the A19 processor used in the iPhone 17e, which is based on 3nm technology.
A move to a smaller manufacturing process could improve processing performance and power efficiency.
However, the actual performance gains, battery improvements and other chipset capabilities will remain unclear until Apple announces the hardware officially.
Earlier reports have also suggested that the iPhone 18e could feature 9GB of RAM, although this detail has not been confirmed by the latest leak.
The front-facing camera could receive one of the most noticeable hardware upgrades on the upcoming iPhone.
According to the reported specifications, the iPhone 18e may feature a 24-megapixel selfie camera, compared with the 12-megapixel front camera on the iPhone 17e.
The higher-resolution sensor could offer more detail in selfies and provide an upgrade for users who frequently make video calls or capture front-camera photographs.
On the rear, Apple is tipped to retain a single 48-megapixel camera.
This suggests that the company may continue with a single-camera setup rather than introducing an additional rear sensor.
Details about other camera features, video recording capabilities and image-processing improvements have not been confirmed.
The iPhone 18e is expected to arrive in spring 2027, according to current reports.
Apple launched the iPhone 17e in March 2026, and the company could follow a similar launch schedule for its successor.
The iPhone 18e is also expected to be part of Apple’s revised iPhone launch strategy, with the more affordable models arriving separately from the premium lineup.
The standard iPhone 18 and the next-generation iPhone Air are also tipped to arrive around the same period.
However, Apple has not announced an official launch date, and the reported timeline should be treated as an estimate.
Apple has not revealed the expected price of the iPhone 18e in India or other markets.
For reference, the iPhone 17e launched in India at Rs 64,900 for its base 256GB variant in March 2026.
The pricing of its successor could depend on component costs, hardware upgrades and Apple’s market strategy.
There is currently no confirmed information about the iPhone 18e’s storage variants or India launch price.
The latest leaks suggest that the iPhone 18e could bring a new processor and a higher-resolution selfie camera while retaining a 60Hz OLED display and a single rear camera.
If these reports prove accurate, the smartphone could appeal to buyers looking for newer Apple hardware without opting for the company’s premium models.
However, those expecting a major display or camera-system upgrade may need to wait for further details.
Apple has yet to confirm the device, its specifications, pricing or release schedule.
All reported details remain subject to change before the official announcement.
Disclaimer: The specifications, features, pricing expectations and launch timeline discussed in this article are based on leaks and media reports.
Apple has not officially confirmed the iPhone 18e or its specifications.
Final details may differ at launch.
